name: docker_python

oracle.check: parsed Dockerfile instruction subset: FROM python:3.12-slim, WORKDIR /app, COPY requirements.txt, direct pip install, nonempty CMD, and no latest base tag

prompt: Return ONLY a Dockerfile (no markdown, no explanation) for a Python app that: uses base image python:3.12-slim, sets WORKDIR to /app, copies requirements.txt and runs pip install, and sets a CMD. Pin the base image tag (do not use latest).
